description: SQL-UNION-02, deciding variant: a Null literal first arm against each column type (a Null-first Long arm returned Text holding raw bytes). For each column of Ut (Long l, Double d, Date dt, Currency c, Text t, Yes/No y) asks SELECT Null AS v FROM One UNION SELECT col FROM Ut, the same with UNION ALL, and the reversed arm order, with the schema (Name, Type, Size) read before the first move and every value. Follow-up probe (status F) for SQL-UNION-02, SQL-UNION-01; runs on a read-only open of fixture r-q-expr-sql-main through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
